sqlpipe v2.0 — Release Notes

Breaking change: The `name` field in `/v2/users` no longer exists. The API now returns two separate fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. If your code reads the `name` field, you must update it before you upgrade. Read `first_name` and `last_name` instead of `name`.

New flag: `--incremental`. This flag limits a run to rows that changed since the last run. Use this flag on large tables to reduce run time. The flag is optional. By default, sqlpipe runs a full sync.

Performance: Parquet writes in v2.0 are 40% faster than Parquet writes in v1. The new writer batches rows before it writes them to disk.

If you use the `name` field in any script, update the script now.
